::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
One of China's three major OSAT firms alongside JCET and Tongfu, founded December 2003 with roots in a state-owned enterprise; its largest shareholder, Tianshui Huatian Microelectronics Co., holds 23%, with the remaining float heavily retail-owned (57%) — an unusually dispersed ownership structure for a Chinese semiconductor firm of this scale.
:::

**Chinese name:** 华天科技 (Huátiān Kējì)

## What does this facility make?

Chip assembly, test, and wafer-level/advanced packaging services.

## Why does it matter?

Based in Gansu province — a notable geographic outlier among China's semiconductor firms, most of which cluster in the Yangtze River Delta (Jiangsu/Shanghai) or Pearl River Delta (Guangdong) regions.
